verdict.rationale: Memory specifications are a fair question for a laptop processor, so the story applies. However, none of the Intel pages in the evidence pack state the memory type, maximum capacity, bandwidth, or channel/speed details needed to derive bandwidth. The evidence covers only marketing claims about graphics, AI engines, NPU TOPS, and developer toolkits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can size memory-bound workloads from the vendor's own numbers — published memory type, capacity ceiling, and bandwidth (or spec detail complete enough to derive it)
